title: Breaking the Central Bias: Spatially Partitioned Experts for Coordinate-Based Neuroevolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.11518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evolvable-Substrate HyperNEAT (ES-HyperNEAT), a bio-inspired indirect encoding that determines neuron placement and connection weights from spatial coordinates, exhibits a failure mode on MNIST as a diagnostic benchmark. Because input pixels map to a coordinate space centered at the origin, evolved networks converge on a small central cluster of input pixels, a spatial-concentration bias; prior work observed only 21% mean accuracy in this regime. Is this bias an optimization artifact or an architectural ceiling? Inspired by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) principles, we partition the input into non-overlapping spatial segments, each assigned to a separately evolved specialist network. With 13 such experts, this design reaches 43% mean accuracy, a 106% relative improvement over the baseline. The architectural gain does not depend on data-driven aggregation: equal-weighted averaging, which uses no validation data, already yields a 70% improveme

translated_title: 打破中心偏置：面向基于坐标的神经进化的空间分区专家方法
translated_abstract: 可进化基底HyperNEAT（ES-HyperNEAT）是一种受生物启发的间接编码方法，它根据空间坐标来确定神经元的放置位置和连接权重。在以MNIST作为诊断基准的测试中，该方法表现出一种失效模式：由于输入像素映射到以原点为中心的坐标空间，进化出的网络会收敛到集中于中心区域的一小簇输入像素，形成空间集中偏置；先前的工作在这种设置下仅观察到21%的平均准确率。这种偏置究竟是优化过程中的偶然现象，还是架构上的固有上限？受混合专家原理的启发，我们将输入划分为互不重叠的空间片段，并将每个片段分配给一个单独进化的专家网络。采用13个这样的专家，该设计达到了43%的平均准确率，相比基线实现了106%的相对提升。这种架构上的收益并不依赖于数据驱动的聚合方式：即使使用不使用任何验证数据的等权平均，也已经能带来70%的提升。
tldr: 本文提出将输入空间划分为互不重叠的空间片段并为每个片段单独进化专家网络的架构，打破了ES-HyperNEAT中进化网络过度集中于中心像素的空间偏置，将MNIST平均准确率从21%提升至43%。
en_tdlr: This paper partitions the input space into non-overlapping spatial segments, each assigned to a separately evolved expert network, breaking the central spatial-concentration bias in ES-HyperNEAT and improving mean MNIST accuracy from 21% to 43%.
